WITH weird_showcases AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT case_link
    FROM EnvironmentalReadingsCore
    WHERE TEMPc IS NOT NULL
      AND (TEMPc < 10 OR TEMPc > 30 OR tempVar24 > 2)
),
valuable_artifacts AS (
    SELECT ART_link, 
           (rating_profile->>'exhibit_value')::numeric as exhibit_val,
           (rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::numeric as cultural_sc
    FROM ArtifactRatings
    WHERE rating_profile->>'exhibit_value' IS NOT NULL
      AND (rating_profile->>'exhibit_value')::numeric > 0
)
SELECT ac.ARTregID, ac.art_title, va.exhibit_val, va.cultural_sc
FROM ConditionAssessments ca
JOIN ArtifactsCore ac ON ca.art_exam = ac.ARTregID
JOIN Showcases s ON ca.case_exam = s.caseID
JOIN valuable_artifacts va ON ac.ARTregID = va.ART_link
WHERE ca.case_exam IN (SELECT case_link FROM weird_showcases)
ORDER BY va.exhibit_val DESC;

),

    SELECT "ART_link", 
           (rating_profile->>'exhibit_value')::numeric as exhibit_val,
           (rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::numeric as cultural_sc
    FROM "ArtifactRatings"
    WHERE rating_profile->>'exhibit_value' IS NOT NULL

)

WHERE ca.case_exam IN (SELECT case_link FROM weird_showcases)
ORDER BY va.exhibit_val DESC;
